r.경제 체제: Resource economy shrunk by civil war · gas, rice, gems

r.정치 구도: Since the 2021 military coup, civil war has raged between the military and pro-democracy and ethnic armed groups.

t.why: It links the Indian Ocean with inland China, so Chinese pipeline and port projects run through it. The civil war has driven many refugees into neighboring countries.
t.rel: Civil war since the 2021 coup has destabilized its borders with China, Thailand and India. China exerts influence over both the military and ethnic armed groups, while the West keeps up sanctions.
t.know: In 2017 the Rohingya fled en masse to Bangladesh to escape a military crackdown, drawing international condemnation.
t.etext: It sells natural gas, rice, clothing, gems and rare earths. The 2021 coup and civil war have shrunk the economy sharply and weakened the currency.
